data.body: Re-measured 2026-10-24 04:55 PDT, read-only CloudWatch (profile frontier, us-east-1, namespace rebar/host, 1-hour buckets over the last 7 days): disk_used_percent{mount=/var/gerrit}, gerrit_healthy and reviewbot_healthy each have datapoints in 168 of 168 hours. This matches the 2026-09-20 measurement above, so AC1's premise (three metrics silent for 7+ days) does not hold now; whatever silenced them during the 2026-09 outage was not diagnosed here. Left open deliberately: AC2 to AC5 ask for a capability, not a fix (a stop-publishing detector based on datapoint recency, an audit of all rebar/host metrics, and a check that fails if it stops running). That is a design and scope decision, and under the project.portability criterion it must be operation-linked or in-process rather than tied to one CI system. Suggest re-scoping this ticket to that capability, or splitting it into a task.
